note: Group records for #270 reputation (honor-west TRANSFER-MAP §2.1), landed by the honor wiring P0 (2026-10-29). Ships with CLASSES documented and ZERO instances — group instances (which towns, dojos, and services are groups, with their thresholds and effect rows) are world content, an owner slot (§5.8), authored with the map. Per-group thresholds VARY as the design (FNV: Goodsprings 3/8/15 vs Legion 15/50/100) — any one-global-table proposal contradicts the donor; a group record may omit thresholds to inherit standing-grid.json's defaults. A record's shape: { id, displayName (owner data), class, thresholds?: { range2, range3, range4 }, valence, homeAreaId?, hateThreshold?, seeThrough?: boolean, effects?: standingEffects rows }.
